acheck

The goal of acheck is to streamline data verification, cleaning, sampling, and reporting workflows.

Installation

You can install the development version of acheck like so:

# install.packages("devtools")
pak::pkg_install("bokola/acheck")

Basic Examples 

library(acheck)

# clean string inputs safely
clean_string("  Nachola124! ")
#> [1] "nachola124"

# clean phone numbers by standardizing county codes
df_phones <- data.frame(telephone_number = c("712345678", "0712345678"))
clean_phone_number(df_phones, col = "telephone_number")
#>   telephone_number
#> 1     254712345678
#> 2     254712345678

# categorize numeric inputs
cut_numeric(c(1, 5, 12, 19, 25), breaks = c(-Inf, 18, Inf), labels = c("<18", ">=18"))
#> [1] <18  <18  <18  >=18 >=18
#> Levels: <18 >=18

Core Functions Summary

Function Description
format_num() Formats numeric vectors using gtsummary styles.
add_gt_to_word() Appends gtsummary objects directly into Word documents.
clean_username() Standardizes string formats to clean title case.
export_list_to_word() Exports a list of data frames or tables to a Word file.
create_summary_table() Builds customizable gtsummary tables.
create_survey_summary_table() Generates summary tables for weighted survey design objects.
create_listing_table() Creates formatted record listings with gtreg.
clean_string() Converts strings to lowercase and strips non-alphanumeric characters.
clean_phone_number() Normalizes Kenyan phone numbers by prepending 254.
process_payroll() Runs comprehensive cleaning pipelines on payroll data frames.
clean_camp() Recodes beneficiary location labels into standardized refugee camps.
get_group_cols() Extracts variable names from data dictionaries by positional index.
check_esr_registrations() Checks for duplicate household entries across dataset pairs.
get_standard_villages() Splits and standardizes multi-village entries.
find_extra_agency_records() Identifies unmatched audit records between datasets.
grep_columns_in_list() Searches for matching column names across lists of data frames.
pull_kobo_data() Fetches survey submissions directly from KoboToolbox API.
pull_kobo_data_mpca() Downloads and aligns complex multi-version Kobo dataset structures.
clean_kobo_excel() Normalizes manual Excel exports to match API formatting standards.
cut_numeric() Bins numeric vectors into labeled factor categories.
export_to_excel_formatted() Writes summary objects to Excel with custom formatting rules.
export_to_excel_appended() Appends new worksheets safely to existing Excel workbooks.
get_duplicates() Returns duplicate record instances based on key variables.
get_distinct() Deduplicates records based on phone and name variations.
plot_bar() Generates standard summary bar charts using ggplot2.
plot_bar_top_n() Plots frequency distributions filtered to top NN categories.
plot_age_gender() Builds age-gender population pyramids using patchwork.
patchwork_grid() Arranges multiple plots into structured grid layouts.
add_custom_total() Calculates custom summary aggregate rows for data frames.
collapse_villages() Merges shared target rows while concatenating village labels.
get_partial_matches() Detects approximate string inclusion between two variables.
get_partial_matches_extend() Maps the best string match between data frames using Jaro-Winkler distances.
get_pii() Isolates personally identifiable information from datasets.
write_list_to_excel() Writes a list of data frames into a single Excel workbook.
flatten_dm_by_names() Extracts and flattens relational data models (dm) into data frame lists.
preprocess_reg() Runs complete pre-processing logic for registration data.
preprocess() Standardizes demographic variables, labels, and categories.
slice_reg() Filters registration records based on target date boundaries.
get_edit_data() Imports and prepares partner data modification files.
draw_pps_sample() Draws a Probability Proportional to Size (PPS) household sample.
draw_pps_hamilton() Performs PPS sampling using the Hamilton largest-remainder method.
draw_strs_sample() Draws a Stratified Simple Random Sample across strata.
draw_cluster_sample() Performs two-stage cluster random sampling across villages.
draw_systematic_across_villages() Executes systematic random sampling across ordered clusters.
